title: Associate Engineer – 87 Posts
age_limit: Upper age limit is 32 or 37 years depending on position code as on 31.10.2026
summary: Engineers India Limited (EIL) invites online applications for experienced engineers on a fixed-term basis across various technical disciplines for a total of 87 vacancies. Selection involves screening followed by a walk-in personal interview at designated EIL offices.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) degree with a minimum of 60% marks in the relevant discipline.
Required post-qualification relevant experience ranges from 2 to 5 years depending on the position code.
Upper age limit is 32 or 37 years as on 31.10.2026, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the career link on the official EIL website at http://www.engineersindia.com.
Carefully read all instructions and complete the online registration form with accurate details.
Upload scanned copies of a passport-size photograph (max 75 KB) and signature (max 25 KB) in .jpg/.jpeg format.
Take 6 printouts of the submitted online application form, affix a colour photograph, and bring them along with original documents for the walk-in interview.
